items.title: #446 FQCN index drops same-line sibling PHP types (false negative)
items.summary: #446 FQCN index drops same-line sibling PHP types (false negative). Current semantic status: UNKNOWN.
items.recommendation: #446 FQCN index drops same-line sibling PHP types (false negative) affects ix-infrastructure/Ix/core-ingestion (PHP namespace resolution). Historical registry status was FIXED_FORK; recommendation: Fork commit f577492 (fix/446-namespace-scope-boundary, parent 0a7d97f) drops the container exclusion in phpTypeFqcn and ambiguousPhpTypeNames — PHP types (class/interface/trait/enum) can never nest, so a container on one is always a same-line artifact. Regression tests fail-before/pass-after; resolveEdges+queries.php+patchBuilder 115/115, tsc clean. Ready for maintainer cherry-pick. Note: the second-order sweep's 'FQCN path immune by construction' claim was about member-binding (false positives); this is a false negative on a different axis. Cross-batch verification (three-state matrix, base 043bc68 / PR 83b9be4 / fixed f577492): the same-line and three-on-line cases drop to NONE in BOTH the in-batch and cross-batch (buildGlobalResolutionIndex -> resolveEdges globalIndex) paths on 83b9be4, and f577492 restores IMPORTS @0.9 on all six cells — the fix is sufficient for every phpFqcnToTypes producer (global builder, resolveEdges merge) and the importedPhpType consumer, all of which share phpTypeFqcn. CLI builds the global index per run in memory (ingest.ts) — no serialized cache. Nested-class (invalid PHP) case captures no entity and is identical on PR and fixed..

items.title: PHP grouped `use Vendor\{A, B};` captures zero IMPORTS
items.summary: PHP grouped `use Vendor\{A, B};` captures zero IMPORTS. Current semantic status: PR_OPEN.
items.recommendation: PHP grouped `use Vendor\{A, B};` captures zero IMPORTS affects ix-infrastructure/Ix/core-ingestion (PHP query / import resolution). Historical registry status was PR_OPEN; recommendation: Fixed by fork commit 5efd8f1 (branch fix/php-grouped-use-imports, parent 043bc68), opened as upstream PR #448. Adds a grouped-use query pattern (namespace_name @import.prefix + namespace_use_clause @import.clause) and rebuilds each member FQCN from prefix + the clause's FIRST name child (an `as` alias is a second name child and never becomes an import). Regression tests fail-before on main / pass-after; relevant suites 86/86, tsc clean. Pre-existing query-layer gap, base==head — NOT a #446 regression, opened independently..
